nodes.label: Qwen3.8 Code Review Report
nodes.rationale: Automated code review of FaceAndVoiceRecV2 repository (114 files) performed by Qwen3.8-27B model. Identified security risks in Docker device exposure and a test robustness concern.

nodes.label: Docker Compose Linux Devices
nodes.rationale: Exposes /dev/video0 and /dev/snd to the container for camera and audio access. Code review flagged MEDIUM security risk: raw host device access is broader than necessary; /dev/snd directory mount exposes all sound nodes rather than specific PCM devices required.

nodes.label: Face Backend Module
nodes.rationale: Implements a lazy singleton (UniFaceBackend) using double-checked locking with threading.Lock. Code review confirmed the pattern is correct: outer check avoids lock after creation, inner check prevents duplicate construction, exception leaves instance None for retry.

nodes.label: Realtime Unit Test
nodes.rationale: Code review flagged LOW risk: monkeypatch.setattr with raising=False at line 1803 may mask missing init_db attribute during test setup, potentially hiding typos or patching the wrong object.
